reviewer_type: AI visual review, not a human observer

display.limits: Original individual PNGs were supplied to the model image viewer at original detail. This does not establish a calibrated physical display or exact camera/door angles. No contacts or MP4s used for decisions.

stationary_closed.notes: Generated wall, window, floor and closed wooden door remain recognizable and nearly stationary across all17 frames. Minor edge/texture drift is visible, with no material viewpoint turn. Target remains exactly the same closed-door view. This matches the no-change condition; it does not by itself demonstrate learned action response.

stationary_interact.notes: Generated wooden door remains visibly closed in every frame0..16, with only minor edge/texture changes and a nearly fixed view. Target opens atframe1 to reveal the table, blue object and gold sphere in the room behind, and stays open through16. No generated opening or revealed room is visible.

left_closed.notes: Across all17 original frame pairs, generated door, wall and window stay close to the initial view with minor edge drift. The target moves progressively toward the window and plant side, shifting the door toward the right border and partly out of frame by16. Generated footage does not show that coherent progressive left turn; its door stays visibly closed throughout.

left_interact.notes: All 17 generated frames retain a nearly fixed view of the closed wooden door. Target opens at frame 1 and shifts progressively toward the window and plant side, with the open doorway moving toward the right border. The generated frames show neither the opening and revealed inner room nor that progressive left turn; minor edge and texture drift remains coherent.
